body:
Moved from DM-268 by the orchestrator (they are in DM-269's scope, DM-174..178) — fix and pin here:
- DM-175: withdrawing the base report of a duplicate-joined defect group falls back to the earliest report rather than a live one sharing its judgement (src/core/space/defects.ts `defectOf`); a late reconcileAttempt resubmit changes the attempt state read at an older cutoff (verification.ts `stateAt`); pin same-call report + fix/withdrawal reading in call order and the judgement-group cases (3-report, alternating, duplicate citing a later report); reviewer repros in %TEMP%/dm175-review/adv*.ts.
- DM-176: a redundant agent active_ms self-report on an attempt the host already covers with placed spans blanks ticket and run T (efficiency.ts runScopes `refused`, timingActivity.ts spanOf before preferHost; repro %TEMP%/dm176-review/adv3.ts G1/G1b) — do not count a refused agent record as a gap when the host reports placed spans for the same identity; full-run efficiency read is tickets x run records when run-level host spans keep arriving (7.7 s at 120 tickets/12k observations, perf2.ts) — narrow the reprojection trigger and pin it structurally (no wall-clock gates); pin the cohort-frozen-at-dispatch cases (adv4.ts).
